notes: Historical FY2023-FY2025 financials are sourced from Intuitive Surgical’s FY2025 Form 10-K: total revenue and Income from operations (used as EBIT proxy). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))

EBIT is defined here as Income from operations (i.e., interest is excluded). If your DCF pipeline computes EBIT differently (e.g., EBIT = pre-tax + interest), adjust accordingly. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))

D&A is approximated using cash-flow line items: (1) Depreciation and loss on disposal of property, plant and equipment, net plus (2) Amortization of intangible and other assets. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))

Capex is approximated as 'Purchases of property, plant, and equipment' from the cash-flow statement. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))

NWC construction: (Accounts receivable + Inventory + Prepaids and other current assets) − (Accounts payable + Accrued compensation and employee benefits + Deferred revenue + Other accrued liabilities), excluding Cash and Investments by not including them in current assets. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))

NWC may differ from a pipeline’s alternative working-capital definition (e.g., exclusion/inclusion of lease-related receivables within prepaids and other current assets, or treatment of deferred commissions/revenue). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))

Tax rate is set to FY2025 effective tax rate (GAAP) derived from the company’s income tax expense versus income before taxes. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))

WACC is set to 0.135 (13.47%) based on market-data proxy from StockAnalysis.com; this is an input assumption rather than a filing-derived capital structure model. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/isrg/statistics/))

NOL balance is set to $85.4M federal/state net operating loss carryforwards as of Dec 31, 2025; NOL utilization percent is a modeling assumption (0.80) because the filing does not provide a pipeline-ready utilization rate. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))

Comps: EV/Sales and EV/EBITDA are taken from StockAnalysis.com valuation ratios; the site is not explicitly labeling these as NTM within the captured snippet, so they are treated as directional. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/mdt/statistics/))

catalysts: Re-acceleration (or further deceleration) in da Vinci procedure growth relative to the 2026 guided 13%-15% range. ([globenewswire.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/01/22/3224266/7637/en/Intuitive-Announces-Fourth-Quarter-Earnings.html?utm_source=openai))

Sustained improvement in operating margin/operating leverage if mix shifts toward higher-margin activity and/or gross margin holds. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))

Changes in working capital intensity (inventory/receivables/deferred revenue) that affect free-cash-flow conversion vs. base-case NWC assumptions. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))
company_overview: Intuitive Surgical is a global technology leader in minimally invasive robotic-assisted surgery, anchored by the da Vinci platform. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))

The company reports one operating segment under US GAAP, simplifying model structure for DCF inputs. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))

Revenue is split between Product and Service lines, with Service forming a recurring component tied to the installed base. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))
current_context: In its Q4 2025 press release (Jan 22, 2026), management guided worldwide da Vinci procedure growth for 2026 at approximately 13%-15% (vs. 18% in 2025). ([globenewswire.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/01/22/3224266/7637/en/Intuitive-Announces-Fourth-Quarter-Earnings.html?utm_source=openai))

FY2025 results show Total revenue of $10,064.7M and Income from operations (EBIT proxy) of $2,945.5M. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))

Balance sheet remains liquid, with Cash and cash equivalents of $3,368.0M and Short-term + long-term investments of $5,666.1M as of Dec 31, 2025. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))
investment_highlights: Base case models continued deceleration in revenue growth (from FY2025’s strong rate) while maintaining near-recent EBIT margin levels. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))

DCF build emphasizes operating profitability (EBIT margin) supported by scale across Service and Product revenues. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))

Cash generation is reinforced by recurring economics: FY2025 operating cash flow of $3,030.5M with maintenance/normalization capex assumptions in the model. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))

Working capital intensity is explicitly modeled via NWC as a percent of sales to reflect the ongoing build of receivables/inventory/deferred revenue typical for the business model. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))
key_risks: Procedure growth shortfall or adverse regional mix versus the guided cadence can pressure revenue growth and margin trajectory. ([globenewswire.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/01/22/3224266/7637/en/Intuitive-Announces-Fourth-Quarter-Earnings.html?utm_source=openai))

Tariffs/reimbursement/regulatory dynamics and competitive pressures could constrain margins or utilization economics. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001035267/000103526726000010/isrg-20251231.htm))

Model sensitivity to WACC and terminal growth is high given the long-duration nature of cash flows (especially with gordon-growth terminalization). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/isrg/statistics/))

Comps use EV/Sales, EV/EBITDA, and forward P/E from a focused medtech peer set to triangulate the implied valuation range alongside the DCF. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/mdt/statistics/))
